title: observability-weekly-2026-06-29
content:
Observability team - Weekly notes (week of 2026-06-29)

Attendees: Priya Shah (owner), Marcus Lee, Hanako Tanaka, Diego Alvarez, Kara Nguyen (SRE), Tomás Herrera (serving-runtime) — standups daily 10:30am PT.

Summary highlights:
- Tracing: rolled out sampling tweak (adaptive frontdoor sampling) to prod canary; initial results show 18% drop in span volume without losing error visibility.
- Dashboards: migrated request-latency dashboards to new metrics namespace and fixed the broken 95th p50/p95 aggregation bug. New per-route latency panel added to console route overview.
- Cost telemetry: prototype cost attribution export is running in staging; first pass matches billing to model routes within ~6% variance. Need to reconcile reserved capacity adjustments.

Standup / daily highlights (notes to self & quick logs):
- Mon 06/29: Marcus: completed sampling config schema change, opened PR (see linked PR). Hanako: investigated dashboard query slowness -> found expired rollup job; re-run fixed panels. Diego: started E2E test harness for cost exports.
- Tue 06/30: Canary for adaptive sampling rolled to 5% traffic. Observed drop in tracing ingest, no missing error traces for few incident replays. Action: monitor for 48h, add alert if error-trace reduction > 30% (Kara).
- Wed 07/01: Dashboards rework complete for latency; added per-route drop-down filter; noticed some routes showing unexpectedly high p95 due to spike in long-sequence requests — filed OBS-1148.
- Thu 07/02: Cost telemetry export format discussion with product; agreed on CSV+route-tag canonicalization. Diego to add experimental field route_version in export.
- Fri 07/03: Weekly sync with SRE and serving-runtime. Agreed on fallback policy for tracing ingest overloads (sample by error and traces-with-slow-ops). Follow-up: Tomás to provide expected qps distributions for next 2 months.

Status by area:
1) Tracing
- Progress: Adaptive frontdoor sampling deployed (canary 5% -> 20% later this week). Early numbers: -18% spans, CPU usage on ingest pipeline down ~12% in canary nodes.
- Open tasks:
  * OBS-1142: finalize sampling UI (owner: Marcus). Blocked by UI schema finalization (product).
  * Add alert: trace_ingest_drop_pct > 30% for 1h (owner: Kara).
- Risks: If sampling over-filters noisy error bursts, we could miss SLO regressions. Mitigation: error-priority path always sampled, and we have retention of full traces for flagged incidents.

2) Dashboards
- Progress: Completed migration to metric-v2 for latency and qps metrics. Dashboard load time down from ~4.8s -> ~2.1s in staging.
- Open tasks:
  * OBS-1148: investigate p95 spikes on long-seq routes (owner: Hanako).
  * Add cost-per-token panel to model route dashboard (owner: Priya).
- Notes: Need consistent naming for route tags (route, model_variant, deployment_zone) — product will finalize naming in Confluence page.

3) Cost telemetry
- Progress: Prototype exporter staging -> matches billing within ~6% for last week. Export schema v0.1 reviewed in sync.
- Open tasks:
  * Create reconciliation job to reconcile reserved capacity adjustments (owner: Diego).
  * Add quantization tag mapping for cost-per-token model (owner: Priya).
- Questions: Should we export cost by customer tag or by route? Product prefers route-first with customer rollup as optional column.

Blockers and unresolved items:
- Sampling UI (OBS-1142) blocked on product schema changes; meeting scheduled 2026-07-07.
- Dashboard naming conventions not finalized (product owner action).
- Cost telemetry: reserved capacity adjustments causing spikes in per-route cost estimates — need billing team input (cc: finance).

Action items / owners (this week):
- Marcus: finish sampling UI prototype and open PR for UI changes (due 2026-07-09).
- Hanako: deep-dive on p95 spikes, include synthetic repro and traces (due 2026-07-06).
- Diego: implement reserved-capacity reconciliation job in staging, start reconciliation runs (due 2026-07-13).
- Kara: implement trace_ingest_drop_pct alert and test on canary (due 2026-07-02).
- Priya: add cost-per-token panel to route dashboard and coordinate tag naming (due 2026-07-09).
- Tomás: share Q3 qps projections for serving runtime (due 2026-07-08).

Meeting notes (sync with SRE & Serving-runtime 07/03):
- Agreed fallback tracing policy: if ingest pipeline load > 70% sustained for 10m then switch to error-priority sampling + drop 80% of low-value traces. Implementation details in Confluence (see linked_artifacts).
- Serving-runtime will provide revised model variant tags to match route_version field. Action: Tomás to attach sample mappings.

Misc / Notes to self:
- Keep an eye on tracing ingest CPU after canary expands. Set up automated dashboard to track span ingestion and tail-latency for ingest nodes.
- Add small eval dataset of recent incidents to ensure sampling changes don't drop essential traces.
- Slack: sticky thread #observability pinned message for canary updates.

Draft status: document is a working note; will convert to finalized weekly summary after next sync and once sampling UI blocker resolved.

References / Links:
- Confluence: Tracing Roadmap (linked_artifacts)
- Jira: OBS-1142 (sampling UI), OBS-1148 (p95 spike), OBS-1135 (cost-export schema)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/378
